question: ML Vasantha Kumari, a renowned vocalist, was known for which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer **Carnatic music**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__​**

__
 
• ML Vasantha Kumari Had been a **Carnatic musician and playback singer.**
 
• Her father,** Kuthanur Ayya Swamy Iyer, was a noted musician.**
 
• Her **mother, Lalithangi, was also a great musician.**
 
• She was the **youngest female awardee of the Sangita Kalanidhi award**
 
• She also awarded **Padma Vibhushan in 1977**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Folk music**

 
 
• ** **Generally, rural music that originally was **passed down through families** and other small social groups
 
• The tradition of folk music is transferred orally than through reading.
 
 
 
• **Hindustani music**
 
 
• ​Hindustani music consists of two classical music**, practiced in north India and Carnatic music in south India.**
 
• Both **diverged from Bharat's Natya shastra in the 14th century.**
 
• **Tabla, Sarangi, Sitar, violin., Santoor and Flute** are used in Hindustani music
 
• **Dhrupad, Khayal, Tarana Style, Thumri, Tappa, and Ghazal are the major styl**e of Hindustani music.
 
• **Gwalior, Agra, Jaipur Atrauli, Rangeela(Jaipur), and Kirana(Awadh) are the main music Gharanas.**
 
 
 
• **Sufi music-**
 
 
• Sufi music originated from** Islamic culture**
 
• Entered in India during the rule of the **Delhi Sultanate.**
 
• **Poetry and Ghazal **are performed in Sufi music.
